policy: Keep active T1/global-local/partial/T6/T10, current evidence and transitive retraining inputs; preserve world configuration and manifests at their original paths. Retire older output payloads only. No source, source data, tenant state, keys, environment, docs or tests are removed.

tests.timing: Ran during cleanup preflight; all protected pipeline artifacts subsequently verified unchanged by SHA-256.

size_note: Sum of removed file lengths; not a measurement of physical disk space reclaimed, because some historical files may have been hardlinked.
